authorized_planning_terms.typed_owner_boundary: HCM-3.5 may plan and freeze the exact typed handbook-engine, handbook-flow, and handbook-pipeline owner boundary and an intentional greenfield cutover. Existing callers are not a legacy-compatibility constraint unless an architectural reason requires a compatibility treatment.
authorized_planning_terms.future_composition: The plan must remain compatible with future standalone Handbook CLI plus crates.io SDK/library composition by Substrate. Tier 2 bundled binary/JSON remains transitional. SDK, CLI, Substrate implementation, publication, registry proof, and consumer adoption remain out of scope.
authorized_planning_terms.promotion_gate: The concrete promotion-gate evaluator/runtime is deferred. HCM-3.5 may plan only a typed, non-promoting evidence boundary.
authorized_planning_terms.delta_signals: HCM-3.4's immutable relation-only snapshot_delta rule remains intact. HCM-3.5 may plan a bounded, redacted, engine-produced delta-signal summary instead of generic delta field reads and must reconcile that form with the reveal_delta_signals target language.

prohibitions: No runtime behavior or runtime check.
No public API implementation or selection beyond the later planning boundary.
No remote, publication, registry proof, SDK/CLI/Substrate implementation, or consumer adoption.
